services.heading: Professional Tree Services for Residential & Commercial Properties

about.heading: Certified Tree Care Professionals Serving Connecticut with Trusted Arborist Services
paragraphs: Erick's Tree Services is a professional tree care company serving residential and commercial properties throughout Connecticut.
With years of hands-on experience, our team specializes in safe and efficient tree removal, trimming, stump grinding, and emergency storm cleanup.

We are committed to delivering reliable service with a strong focus on safety, professionalism, and long-term customer trust. Every project is handled with care, precision, and respect for your property.
Our goal is simple: provide high-quality tree services that keep your property safe, clean, and well maintained.

commercial.heading: Professional Tree Solutions for Commercial Properties
paragraphs: We provide reliable and professional tree care services for commercial properties across Connecticut, working with property managers, business owners, HOAs, construction companies, and real estate developers. Our team is equipped to handle everything from large-scale tree removal and land clearing to routine maintenance, stump grinding, and emergency storm response.

We help keep your properties safe, clean, and fully operational by delivering efficient work with minimal disruption to your daily operations. Every project is handled by experienced arborists using professional equipment, with a strong focus on safety, reliability, and long-term property value.

process.heading: Simple, Safe & Efficient Tree Service Process
process.description: At Erick's Tree Services, we make it easy to get the tree services you need without hassle. It's easy and here is our process.

steps.title: Book your request
steps.description: Contact our team by phone or online form. We'll gather basic details about your project and schedule a convenient time for an assessment.

steps.title: On-Site Evaluation
steps.description: Our experts visit your property to evaluate the situation, identify risks, and determine the best and safest approach for the work required.

steps.title: Professional Service Execution
steps.description: Our trained crew completes the job using professional equipment and strict safety standards, ensuring efficient and precise results.

steps.title: Cleanup & Final Inspection
steps.description: We thoroughly clean the site and perform a final inspection to make sure everything is safe, clear, and left in excellent condition.
